$schema.description: Schema URL used by editors for validation and autocomplete.

layerZIndex.description: Base z-index applied to non-default layers (modals, tooltips, etc.). Defaults to 100.

layerMode.description: Position non-default layers relative to the app root or viewport. Defaults to root.

showDevTools.description: Automatically mount the dockable DevTools UI over your app. Defaults to false.

strictIds.description: Throw when duplicate logical widget IDs are produced in one frame. Defaults to false.

strictRuntime.description: Turn runtime invariant diagnostics into frame-aborting coded errors. Defaults to false.

stateRetentionFrames.description: Committed frames that absent widget state and memo entries remain in memory before cleanup. Defaults to 1.
